thread:
maria: Quick evening transfer — I'm handing off to tj for the 18:00-02:00 window. Short list of what changed since morning:
- model-serving: rollout v2.4 started at 16:50 (canary -> 25%). Expect slightly higher p95 on /generate for ~30m while cache warms. :eyes:
- batcher: threshold lowered from 8->6 to reduce tail latency; watch batch sizes in metrics.
- infra: log-collector disk on node gc-3 at 72% (cleanup job scheduled at 19:10).
- experiments: sahil enabled int8 quant test on a dedicated pool (no traffic routed yet).

Action items:
1) tj: monitor p95 and abort rollout if p95 > 250ms for >5min.
2) lee: confirm the cleanup job completed after 19:10 and free at least 10GB.
3) ashley: keep an eye on any 429 spikes from api-proxy; those may be caused by batcher threshold changes.

Quick checks/commands: paste to run if you need fast status:
```
# p95 for /generate last 15m
kubectl exec -it -c metrics tools -- curl http://localhost:9090/query?query=histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/generate"}[15m])) by (le))
# batcher queue length
kubectl logs deploy/batcher --tail 200 | grep "queue_len"
```

I'll be available on pager for the first 30m after handoff. leaving my notes pinned in the watchlist channel. :thumbsup:

---

tj: Thanks — got it. I'll watch p95 and queue size. If p95 breaches 250ms I'll pause the canary and notify infra. Can someone quickly confirm the canary hosts list?

maria: Canary hosts are modelpool-canary-{1..6}, traffic split 25%. The rollout controller logs in /var/log/rollout.log on canary nodes.

sahil: FYI I turned on quant test but didn't add routing. If you see any model mismatch logs, ping me. I also left a note about model-cache invalidation that might temporarily increase backend load.

lee: I'll own the disk cleanup confirmation. Will post once gc job finishes.

ashley: I can watch the 429s and add a temporary rate-limit override if we see spiky 429s from api-proxy. If needed I'll scale api-proxy by +2 replicas.

oncall-bot: Reminder: escalation policy "infra-p1" active 18:00-02:00. Pager on duty: @tj.

tj: got the reminder. Two quick Qs:
1) If I pause rollout, should I route traffic back to v2.3 or to a reduced canary?
2) Any tests I should run before unpausing?

maria: 1) route back to v2.3 stable. We keep a tagged replica set stable-v2.3 for immediate fallback. 2) run smoke against /generate for 5k tokens at 1rps and check for any tokenization errors + model output diffs. I usually run the smoke via our ci-runner: `./scripts/smoke.sh --route stable-v2.3`

tj: perfect. I'll start a 5m baseline check now then watch for 30m.

lee: gc job finished at 19:14 — freed ~12.3GB on gc-3. Log: `gc: deleted 132 archives, freed 12345678923 bytes`

ashley: scaling api-proxy by +2 as a precaution. If we don't see 429s in 15m I'll scale back.

maria: great — thanks all. Leaving the watchlist pinned: key metrics to watch = generate_p95, batcher_queue_len, proxy_429_rate, log-collector_free. I'll be reachable via DM until 18:30 and then offline.

tj: taking over. ping me for any escalations. I'll post a brief update at 19:00 and again at 22:00.

ashley: thx — will update if I see anything. :v:
